security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI M-mode code writes to mpmpdeleg, spmpen, or SPMP entries via indirect CSR access (miselect/mireg/mireg2), then transfers control to S-mode without first executing SFENCE.VMA with rs1=x0 and rs2=x0
security_spec.summary: Missing SFENCE.VMA after SPMP CSR writes lets S-mode observe stale SPMP state, bypassing M-mode-configured memory restrictions
